description: A dramatic, architecturally monumental dining room with an organic-modern luxury character. The ceiling is smooth pale plaster in a warm stone tone, and the back wall is clad in rough-hewn natural stone tiles in dark charcoal and grey. To the left, a floor-to-ceiling built-in display cabinet in pale blonde oak with brass framing and textured glass panes holds a collection of wine bottles and glassware. Adjacent to it, an antique-style Japanese screen or textured glass partition panel creates a vertical accent break. A floating staircase with dark treads and open risers ascends behind the dining area, its underside and surroundings filled with a dramatic live-plant installation — mossy boulders, fern-like greenery, and low sculptural planting that creates a garden grotto atmosphere within the built architecture. The dining table is a large dark espresso-stained oval with a thick pedestal base; it seats eight dining chairs in dark ebonized frames with cream linen upholstered seats and backs. A massive organic moss-and-branch tablescape centerpiece fills the table center. A round low-pile grey rug anchors the seating. The floor appears to be large-format dark stone tile. Warm concentrated light drops down onto the table from overhead, the glow illuminating the centerpiece and casting the chairs in soft shadow. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrically on the oval table, capturing the full room depth with the staircase visible behind.
